title: River Development Agent Production Governed Operation Execution Authorization Acquisition Integration
objective: Integrate deterministic production acquisition of governed operation-execution authorization through the existing trusted execution-authorization and governed-executor foundation chain without creating new authorization semantics or performing repository mutation.
constraints: Do not manufacture, upgrade, or bypass authorization.
Thread exact trusted predecessor results through the existing governed executor integration chain.
Terminate at the existing DEV-307 operation-execution authorization result.
Expose authorization as inert data only.
Do not stage, commit, push, merge, deploy, access secrets, expand scope, or perform external side effects.
acceptanceCriteria: Production integration deterministically composes the existing governed executor authorization chain.
The integration begins from an existing RiverDevExecutionAuthorizationFoundation.
Each governed executor stage receives the exact result of its required predecessor.
The terminal result is the existing DEV-307 RiverDevGovernedExecutorIntegrationOperationExecutionAuthorizationFoundationResult.
Unauthorized or untrusted predecessor state remains denied by existing foundation behavior.
No new authorization state or authorization upgrade is introduced.
The integration itself performs no repository mutation or external side effect.
TypeScript compilation and existing tests remain green.
